[[sn:Coupling]]{{Wikipedia}}

High coupling is bad and low coupling is good

Reduce coupling in design so you can remove and change things only in one point

== Degrees of coupling ==
From highest to lowest

* content coupling
* common coupling
* external coupling
** something external
* control coupling
* stamp coupling
* data coupling
